name: khach_san_grand_canh_nam
sources: The south wing of the Grand Hotel of Vũng Tàu (2 Nguyễn Du), on Quang Trung at the corner of Nguyễn Trãi, from edits (plan 0018). The plan is its footprint in OpenStreetMap (way 118946705, © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL): 39.7 m on Quang Trung, 20.3 m deep.

The front is from a photo of 2015 (trungydang, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0): 3 storeys; a low ground storey between piers; a brown band; two storeys of loggias between orange pilasters, with rails of iron; pale yellow walls; a cornice; a low roof of yellow tiles; a stone with the name in a bed behind a low wall.

A guess: the heights (from a bay of 4.3 m as the scale), 9 bays on Quang Trung, the front on Nguyễn Trãi (4 bays as those of Quang Trung), the north end and the back (no photo), the pattern of the rails.
